patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
index f1a6340..a7850ab 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
@@ -494,7 +494,7 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
                     failure_category=category,
                 )
             else:
-                self._reject_completion(state, admission.reasons, contract)
+                self._reject_completion(state, admission.reasons, contract, charge_repair=False)
             return
 
         supporting_observations = list(adapter.view.trace.receipts)
@@ -814,9 +814,26 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
         state: RunState,
         reasons: tuple[str, ...],
         contract: CompletionContract,
+        *,
+        charge_repair: bool = True,
     ) -> None:
         budget = contract.b_req
         state.completion_findings = _stable_unique(reasons)
+        if not charge_repair:
+            # Malformed proposals (bad coverage, trivial checks, policy errors) ran no
+            # checks and used no reviewer call; let the model fix them without spending
+            # repair/review budget. Turn and wall-clock budgets still bound the loop.
+            state.unresolved_errors.extend(state.completion_findings)
+            self._journal.append(
+                "completion_rejected",
+                {
+                    "repair_count": state.repair_count,
+                    "repair_granted": True,
+                    "repair_charged": False,
+                    "reasons": state.completion_findings,
+                },
+            )
+            return
         review_exhausted = (
             self._options.enable_completion_review
             and state.completion_review_count >= budget.max_completion_reviews
